en-US.这是给朋友试用的测试版，不是 Chrome 应用商店版本。功能和银行页面都可能变: This is a beta for friends, not a Chrome Web Store release. Features and bank pages may change; please tell us when something goes wrong.
en-US.这是内部测试版，不是 Chrome 应用商店版本。: This is an internal test build, not a Chrome Web Store release.
en-US.这个版本不提供连接：{0}。这些银行的卡片可以手动添加到钱包，但余额和账单不会自: Not available to connect in this version: {0}. You can add their cards to the wallet by hand, but balances and statements are not read.
en-US.从银行读取什么: What is read from the bank
en-US.不要发送金额、完整卡号、密码、验证码或银行页面截图。: Never send amounts, full card numbers, passwords, codes or screenshots of bank pages.
en-US.每张卡的余额、账单金额、最低还款和还款日。: Each card's balance, statement amount, minimum payment and due date.
en-US.American Express Membership Rewards 和 Ch: American Express Membership Rewards and Chase Ultimate Rewards points; a shared pool is shown once.
en-US.只读取，不付款、不转账、不兑换积分、不登记优惠，也不改银行设置。: Read only: no payments, transfers, redemptions, offer enrolment or bank setting changes.
en-US.登录、密码和手机验证都在银行官网由你自己完成，钱包不读取也不保存它们。: You sign in, enter passwords and confirm on your phone on the bank's own site; the wallet never reads or stores them.
en-US.年费日（持卡周年日）：银行页面不显示，用来计算按卡年重置的福利。: Annual fee date (card anniversary): bank pages don't show it; it sets the cycle for card-year benefits.
en-US.隐藏的卡片：隐藏后总览、积分、福利、提醒和用卡助手都当作你没有这张卡。: Hidden cards: once hidden, the overview, points, benefits, reminders and assistant treat the card as not held.
en-US.不能付款、不能操作银行、不能替你登记优惠。: It cannot pay, act on your bank, or enrol offers for you.
en-US.钱包数据保存在这台电脑的 Chrome 里，不上传，也不同步。: Your wallet stays in Chrome on this computer; it is not uploaded or synced.
en-US.没有广告，也没有使用统计。: No ads and no usage analytics.
en-US.卸载扩展会删除扩展里的数据；需要保留的话，先在“数据管理”里导出备份。: Uninstalling the extension deletes its data; to keep it, export a backup from Data first.
en-US.联名卡的积分（例如航空或酒店计划）不读取。: Co-brand points (airline or hotel programmes, for example) are not read.
en-US.银行页面没有印年份的日期，按读取当天推断最近的年份，并标明是推断的。: A date printed without a year gets the year nearest the day it was read, marked as inferred.
en-US.没读到的金额保持未知，不按零计算；银行页面改版可能让读取暂时失败。: Amounts that weren't read stay unknown, never zero; a bank page redesign can break reading for a while.
en-US.这个测试版只从 {0} 的官网读取余额和账单。: This beta reads balances and statements only from {0}.
en-US.这张卡可以记在钱包里，用来看福利和问用卡助手；它的余额、账单和还款日不会自动更新: You can keep this card in the wallet for its benefits and the assistant; its balance, statement and due date won't update automatically.
en-US.这个版本能做什么、读取什么、数据存在哪里。: What this version does, what it reads and where your data lives.
en-US.AI 服务拒绝了请求，请在设置里检查 AI 服务。: The AI service refused the request. Check the AI service in Settings.
en-US.AI 服务暂时繁忙，请稍后再问。: The AI service is busy. Please ask again later.
en-US.聊天内容和卡片识别由 Cardybara 服务转交 AI 模型处理。服务不保存这: Chat and card recognition go through the Cardybara service to an AI model. The service does not store them; it records only the invite code's id, time, usage and status. Bank balances and statements do not go through the Cardybara service.
en-US.默认关闭。开启后，钱包会把未识别卡片的银行、地区和卡名（不含尾号和金额）发给 A: Off by default. When on, the wallet sends an unrecognised card's bank, region and name (no last digits or amounts) to the AI service, once per name; you confirm the guess in the card details.
en-US.由 AI 服务根据卡名推测，确认前不当作已识别。: Guessed by the AI service from the card name; not treated as recognised until you confirm.
en-US.会把银行、地区和卡名（不含尾号）发给 AI 服务。: Sends the bank, region and card name (no last digits) to the AI service.
en-US.托管服务暂时繁忙，请稍后再试。: The hosted service is busy. Please try again later.
en-US.托管服务还没有开通，请稍后再试。: The hosted service isn't open yet. Please try again later.
en-US.AI 补全未启用，本次只用规则读取: AI completion is off; this read used rules only
en-US.AI 服务拒绝了请求，请在设置里检查 AI 服务: The AI service refused the request; check it in Settings
en-US.它看不到银行余额、账单和还款日；回答里的数字只来自钱包的福利、积分和卡片资料，查: It can't see bank balances, statements or due dates; numbers in its answers come only from the wallet's benefit, points and card data, and when it can't find something it says so instead of guessing.
en-US.只在你点击刷新时读取，不会在后台自动刷新；需要手机验证时要你本人在银行完成。: It reads only when you click refresh, never in the background; phone confirmations must be done by you at the bank.
en-US.Bilt 卡只能手动添加：不连接银行，余额、账单和 Bilt Rewards 积: Bilt cards can only be added by hand: the bank is not connected, and balances, statements and Bilt Rewards points are not read.
en-US.积分估值：每种积分值多少钱，有默认值，可以改；用来比较用哪张卡。: Point valuations: what each kind of point is worth, with a default you can change; used when comparing cards.
en-US.手动添加的卡片：从带卡面的卡种列表里选；常见的 Chase 和 American: Cards you add by hand: pick the product from a list with card images; common Chase and American Express US cards, airline and hotel co-brands included, are in the list.
en-US.可以回答持卡、福利、积分和年费周期的问题，也可以比较一笔消费用哪张卡更好。回答边: Answers questions about your cards, benefits, points and card-year cycles, and compares which card to use for a purchase. Answers appear as they are written.
en-US.部分卡种还没有卡面图片，显示占位图。: Some cards have no card image yet and show a placeholder.
en-US.卡片详情和添加卡片时，从带卡面的列表里选卡种，可以搜索卡名或品牌。: In card details and when adding a card, pick the product from a list with card images, searchable by name or brand.
en-US.读取没完成或有卡片缺少字段时，在“银行连接”里这家银行下面点“生成问题报告”，看: When a read doesn't finish or a card is missing a field, click “Create problem report” under that bank in Bank connections, read the preview, then click “Save report” and send the file to the person who invited you. Amounts, card numbers, names and dates in the report are replaced with placeholders, and nothing is sent automatically.
en-US.也请告诉邀请你的人：哪家银行、哪一步、看到了什么提示。: Also tell the person who invited you which bank, which step, and what message you saw.
en-US.Chase 和 American Express 美国里，少数卡种只有名称和卡面: Among Chase and American Express US cards, a few have only a name and image, with no benefit or earning rules: American Express Green, and Chase Slate, Slate Edge, DoorDash and Instacart. Many cards of other banks have only a name for now, with no benefit rules.
en-US.用卡助手在 Cardybara 服务上运行：服务收到你的问题、这次对话的前文、持: The assistant runs on the Cardybara service: it receives your question, the earlier turns of the conversation, the card products you hold, your point valuations, whether each card has an annual fee date, and the wallet lookups the assistant asks for, and passes them to an AI model; it does not receive card numbers, balances or statements. The service does not store any of it; it records only the invite code's id, time, usage and status.
en-US.Chase 和大部分 American Express 美国卡种显示发卡机构公开: Chase cards and most American Express US cards show the issuer's published card image.
en-US.总览里的“这笔消费，用哪张卡？”：选消费类别，直接给出建议用的卡和其他选择，按你: “Which card for this purchase?” on the overview: pick a category and it shows the card to use and the other choices, from your cards' rules and your point valuations, without limited-time offers.
en-US.需要邀请码：在设置的“AI 服务”里输入邀请你的人给的邀请码。不输入也能正常使用: Needs an invite code: in Settings → AI service, enter the code from the person who invited you. Without it the wallet works, just without the chat assistant and AI card recognition.
en-US.AI 识别卡种默认关闭；开启后，或你在卡片详情里点“用 AI 推测卡种”时，会把: AI card recognition is off by default; when you turn it on, or click “Ask AI for the card type” in card details, the unrecognised card's bank, region and name (no tail or amounts) go through the Cardybara service to the AI.
